core_obligations: Descend local Noetherianity: $Y$ is locally Noetherian by the delivered descent lemma (proof lines 1148-1151).

Choose a scheme $V$ with a surjective \'etale morphism $V \to Y$; by the characterization of regular schemes it suffices to prove that the local rings of $V$ are regular local rings (proof lines 1151-1154).

Choose a scheme $U$ with a surjective \'etale morphism $U \to X \times_Y V$; since $f$ is surjective and flat, $U \to V$ is a surjective flat morphism of schemes, and $U$ is regular with regular local rings (proof lines 1154-1160).
Conclude the local rings of $V$ are regular by the Algebra lemma on flat morphisms under regular schemes (proof lines 1160-1162).
proof_roadmap: Descend local Noetherianity of the target.
Move regularity to a surjective \'etale chart of the target.
Lift to a chart over $X$ where $f$ is a surjective flat morphism of schemes.
difficulty_reason: The proof is a chart transport: descent of local Noetherianity is applied first, then regularity is checked on a surjective \'etale chart $V \to Y$, lifted through a second surjective \'etale chart $U \to X \times_Y V$ on which $f$ becomes a surjective flat morphism of schemes with regular source, and the algebra input that a flat morphism under a regular scheme has regular target concludes.
